issue_description.description: The current implementation was reviewed across the four assigned UI surfaces. Generated supplement prose links inherit the legacy colour, inset underline, and hover transition while inline references retain their explicit exception. Every supplement filter transition starts by closing controlled popovers and resetting the trigger state. The home grid uses constrained widths at 320 pixels and retains the established 390-pixel title, image, overlay, excerpt, and zero-overflow geometry. The social rail switches at the legacy 768-pixel breakpoint and remains inside the viewport through 821 pixels. The focused Chromium E2E run completed with all three selected regressions passing. No code was changed during this audit.
